maddeler.e:
أنتصب (form VIII)
# أَنْتَصِبُ (ʔantaṣibu) /ʔan.ta.sˤi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# أُنْتَصَبُ (ʔuntaṣabu) /ʔun.ta.sˤa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# أَنْتَصِبَ (ʔantaṣiba) /ʔan.ta.sˤi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# أُنْتَصَبَ (ʔuntaṣaba) /ʔun.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
